entries.duty: By appointment. Daily 9:00-19:00, Thursday 9:00-16:00, Saturday 9:00-12:00; call ahead.
entries.note: Source is a 2024 news article (opened); clinic's own site (vetmonaco.com, named by hellomonaco.com) blocked by WebFetch provenance rule, not fetched. Name confirmed also by expatfocus.com. No 24h claim.

entries.name: Clinique Saint-Hubert (Beausoleil, next to Monaco)
entries.address: 7 avenue Général de Gaulle, Beausoleil, France
entries.duty: Out-of-hours on-call service for nights and weekends: +33 6 60 61 36 24. Not a 24-hour clinic; call ahead.
entries.note: In France, directly bordering Monaco. 2024 Monaco Tribune article (opened) describes an on-call ('service d'astreinte') night/weekend service; not described as 24h. Own site not found.

duty_i18n.pl: Dyżur po godzinach w nocy i w weekendy: +33 6 60 61 36 24. Nie jest to przychodnia całodobowa; zadzwoń wcześniej.
duty_i18n.cs: Pohotovostní služba mimo ordinační dobu v noci a o víkendech: +33 6 60 61 36 24. Není to nonstop klinika; předem zavolejte.
duty_i18n.sv: Jourtjänst utanför öppettid för nätter och helger: +33 6 60 61 36 24. Ingen klinik med öppet dygnet runt; ring innan du kommer.
duty_i18n.da: Vagtservice uden for åbningstid om nætter og i weekender: +33 6 60 61 36 24. Ikke en døgnåben klinik; ring på forhånd.
duty_i18n.fi: Päivystys öisin ja viikonloppuisin aukioloaikojen ulkopuolella: +33 6 60 61 36 24. Ei 24 tunnin klinikka; soita etukäteen.
duty_i18n.nb: Vakttjeneste utenom åpningstid for netter og helger: +33 6 60 61 36 24. Ikke en døgnåpen klinikk; ring på forhånd.
duty_i18n.sl: Dežurna služba zunaj rednega časa ob nočeh in koncih tedna: +33 6 60 61 36 24. Ni klinika, odprta 24 ur na dan; vnaprej pokličite.
duty_i18n.hr: Dežurna služba izvan radnog vremena za noći i vikende: +33 6 60 61 36 24. Nije ambulanta koja radi 24 sata; nazovi unaprijed.

notes: Monaco has no public register or duty rota reachable: journaldemonaco.gouv.mc PDF (draft law 1556 annex) blocked by robots (robots_disallowed); the AMPEID copy of the draft law contains no vet list; no gouv.mc / Direction de l'Action Sanitaire / Ordre des Vétérinaires de Monaco list or garde page was found or opened. Clinic's own sites (vetmonaco.com, veterinairesoleil.fr) were refused by WebFetch (PROVENANCE_REQUIRED) and not fetched otherwise. All clinic data therefore rests on one 2024 news article (Monaco Tribune), not an official or clinic source - verify before publishing. No clinic page says 24h, so none is marked 24h. No duty rota and no poison line found (French CNITV pages not opened/covering Monaco). Ordre des Vétérinaires de la Principauté de Monaco contact (per expatfocus.com): 7 Rue Suffren Reymond, +377 93 50 70 10 - not added as an entry (not a clinic/rota). Left out (in France, not Monaco): Clinique vétérinaire canadienne and du Soleil (Cap d'Ail), Vetazur (Cap Martin), Vet Riviera 24/24 Nice (24/24 stated on cotedazurfrance.fr listing; ~15 km away; candidate for FR file).
